Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a lawyer and a sales clerk about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The lawyer got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the sales clerk scored well and was selected. Who is unintelligent?
A. Cannot answer
B. The lawyer
C. The sales clerk
